metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: H1 barrier contract: 4-bar horizon = 4 hours. SL=1.8xATR wider than M5/M15 (1.5x) to account for larger H1 bar noise. TP=2.8xATR gives 1.56:1 RR. ATR computed on H1 candles.
metadata.design_notes: H1 resolution layer in HMRE architecture. 4h window matches intraday swing trading. Wider SL accounts for higher per-bar volatility on H1 timeframe.
